resources.string: Also sync WiiWare and Virtual Console saves

Channels installed from the Wii Shop (WiiWare games and Virtual Console titles) keep their saves in Wii/title/00010001. On: these saves travel as another bundle, kept with the same game. Only the save data goes, never the installed game itself.

Off by default. Written next to the covers in the same media folder, from libretro thumbnails (needs that source switched on in Cover sources). Images that are already there are only replaced when replacing is on below.
The title screen of each game, in the %1$s folder of each console. Only games libretro has one for get one.
A screenshot of each game, in the %1$s folder of each console. Only games libretro has one for get one.
